iterations.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target image 1 is the torn-map draft. Image 2 is the approved STYLE REFERENCE only. Change ONLY the map fragment geometry and its tiny drawn markings: it must unmistakably be HALF of a map, with about 50 percent missing, a tall narrow left-hand fragment with a long strongly irregular torn edge down its right side. The missing half must be TRANSPARENT, not folded behind it and not drawn as a second piece. Show only a few incomplete abstract ink curves which are visibly cut off by the torn edge. Remove mountain, tree, river pictograms and any solved path; no readable labels, X, destinations or symbols. Keep the existing matte gouache, lilac paper, purple ink, soft hand-painted edges and isolated entire subject with transparent margin. No people, no scenery, no shadow or white outline. This is a reusable story object whose authored description is 'a torn map with half missing'; the absence of the other half must read clearly at 160px. Genuine transparent alpha background.

Use case: illustration-story. Image 1 is the approved MagicPaper matte gouache STYLE REFERENCE only. Create ONE isolated torn map fragment for a children's story. It is the LEFT HALF of a roughly square sheet: a broad upright rectangle roughly 2 units wide by 3 units tall, with a straight left outer edge and a strongly jagged torn right edge; the entire right half of the original sheet is missing. Show only TWO short imperfect curving purple ink route segments, abruptly cut off at the jagged torn edge; no frame, grid, labels, text, icons, mountains, trees, destination or X. Soft pale lilac paper, matte dry gouache pigment with gentle irregular painted edges, subtle fold. Complete fragment centered with clear margins on all sides. CRITICAL: absolutely NO glow, halo, shadow, vignette, blur, lighting spill, white outline or surrounding paint. All pixels OUTSIDE the actual paper silhouette must be genuinely fully transparent, not a fog or translucent haze. The torn paper edge itself may be subtly warm fiber color. No beige/cream background. No additional object or scenery, no child, mascot, logo. Preserve contemporary children's book texture and readable simple shape at 160px.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit this exact map image. Remove ALL surrounding purple/white glow, haze and shadow. Keep ONLY the solid lilac paper silhouette and its ink and torn fibers unchanged. Every pixel outside the physical paper edge must have alpha=0. The background must be genuinely transparent, with no vignette, glow, drop shadow, pale cloud, soft halo, blur or light spill. Do not redraw, resize, rotate or recolor the paper or markings. Do not add anything. Preserve the physical map silhouette and its texture exactly; cut away only the unwanted cloudy background.

Illustration-story, one reusable MagicPaper storybook spot asset. Style reference: attached approved gouache illustration, texture and color language only. Draw ONE TRIANGULAR HALF OF A TORN MAP: start from a square lilac map sheet torn diagonally from upper left to lower right, keep only the lower-left triangular half; the upper-right half is completely absent. One rough diagonal paper tear, two straight outer paper edges. A short dashed purple route stops abruptly at the diagonal tear. Matte gouache pigment, soft shapes, simple broad silhouette; natural pale paper fibers along the tear. Center the entire triangle with generous clear margins on a square transparent canvas. Only the actual paper object has color; transparent empty space everywhere else. No typography, pictograms, people or extra objects. No glow, shadows, haze, background or outline.
